title: Security and data
description: Where Implesta stores your data, who can see what, and how every change is recorded. The page to forward to your finance and IT leads.
teaser: Hosting, access by role, audit log and GDPR.
h1: Your data, who sees it, and what is recorded
lead: The facts your finance and IT leads will ask for, in one place.

items.value: What each person can see and change follows their role. Financial data, such as rates, margins and invoice amounts, is only visible to people with finance access.
Every change to clients, contacts, deals, proposals, invoices and profiles is recorded in a log that can't be edited, and can be exported as CSV.
Each signature records the signer's name, title, email, time and a checksum of the signed document.
Clients review proposals, follow projects and approve hours through secure links, without an account in your workspace.
